formDescription: Sub-screen for the 'fosterparent' request topic. Lets the applicant select which record files apply to them as a foster parent and, within each selected file, which specific record types they want.

foster_parent_selection.title: Select the corresponding types of records you would like to receive in your request
foster_parent_selection.description: The more selected, the larger the resulting request. Each main option, once checked, reveals its own set of record-type sub-options.

options.label: Resource (Foster Parent) File
suboptions: Applications, Assessments, Approvals and Licensing Documentation

notes: Main/sub options are loaded dynamically from web/src/app/services/data.json (referenceData.fosterparent).
